g.text: The three pieces of Roblox Reality
the data model: a ledger of every object
takes the engine's flat draft frame
and adds texture, lighting and detail
→ it never decides what is in the scene
Roblox cloud — the base that runs all of this at scale
persists each world's state (come back days later and the game is intact) · runs millions of sessions near the player
authoritative state has to sit beside the player for fast, fair multiplayer
The engine and the cloud hold consistency; the world model handles realism
